name: Husqvarna 365
blurb: 16″, 18″, 20″, 24″ and 28″ bar setups on 3/8″ chain, .050″ / .058″ gauge, 60–93 drive links — straight from Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 365 is a rear-handle gas saw. Husqvarna's own 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026) lists 5 approved bar lengths for it (16″, 18″, 20″, 24″ and 28″), running 3/8″ pitch chain in .050″ / .058″ gauge. The table below restates each row from that guide: the drive-link count changes with bar length, and the guide also names the matching Husqvarna bar and chain part numbers. This saw is listed in more than one gauge (.050″ / .058″), which is where wrong-chain orders come from: the gauge has to match the groove in your bar, so read it off the bar stamp. If your saw wears a replacement bar, trust the stamp over the chart.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 16″ setup with bar X-Tough 596687460 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550060.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 16″ setup with bar X-Force 596199460 and chain C85 X-Cut 581626960.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bar X-Tough 596687468 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550068.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689168 and chain C85 X-Cut 581626968.

Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bar X-Tough 596687472 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550072 / C83S X-Cut 585551272 / C83SK X-Cut 585551472. One chain variant in the guide is a square-ground type that lists “Square” instead of a round-file size.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689172 and chain C85 X-Cut 581626972 / C85S X-Cut 585548972.

Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 24″ setup with bar X-Tough 596687484 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550084 / C83S X-Cut 585551284 / C83SK X-Cut 585551484. One chain variant in the guide is a square-ground type that lists “Square” instead of a round-file size.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 24″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689184 and chain C85 X-Cut 581626984 / C85S X-Cut 585548984.

Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 28″ setup with bar X-Tough 596687493 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550093 / C83S X-Cut 585551293 / C83SK X-Cut 585551493. One chain variant in the guide is a square-ground type that lists “Square” instead of a round-file size.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 28″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689193 and chain C85 X-Cut 581626993 / C85S X-Cut 585548993.
